accepted_findings: The selected current filing is the 10-K for the fiscal year ended 2026-05-31, filed 2026-07-22.
Annual CFO, cash capex, and FCF use the same 2025-06-01 through 2026-05-31 period.
No stale interim FCF is presented as the current cash-flow basis.
The contract remains at Gate 1 and suppresses formal investment action, expected return, target price, portfolio action, and position sizing.

shared_finding.source_sentence: Our available liquidity, including our cash and cash equivalents and amounts available under our committed credit facilities, stood at $1,089.5 million at May 31, 2026.
shared_finding.root_cause: A permissive regex backtracked through the integer portion of 1,089.5 and captured only .5 million as the amount.
shared_finding.decision_impact: The amount was marked PROVISIONAL and did not pass Gate 1 or support an investment conclusion, but a false reported amount is not acceptable in the shared Data and Evidence Layer.

required_next_actions: Require a left numeric boundary and prevent wildcard text from consuming part of the target number in every facility-availability pattern.
Preserve the exact matched phrase and parser rule in the evidence record.
Add regression tests for comma-formatted decimals, misleading available-under phrases, and valid facility availability sentences.
Rerun RPM and verify that the misleading phrase is not reported as facility availability.
Freeze the shared fix and complete S17 on a completely new held-out issuer.
